text:
maya (support): Escalating FluxWare onboarding — customer can't finish SSO and Dedicated provisioning hit a 403. Renewal in ~30 days, flagging as high risk if we don't unblock today.
liam (cs): Copy. What specifically is failing? Need logs/screenshots.
maya (support): SAML flow throws `Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) mismatch` in browser. Then API call to /v1/provision returns 403. Screenshot attached in thread. Happened right after customer updated their ACS URL in IdP.
liam (cs): OK assigning to @sara to own customer comms. @raj for engineering triage on provisioning 403.
sara (cs): On it. I'll ping the customer in 10m with a short status and ETA.
raj (eng): Quick find: the tenant routing table for fluxware didn't bind after their rekey; provisioner returned 403 because tenant_id wasn't present in route table. I'm running a reseed now: ```/bin/reseed-tenant --tenant fluxware --region=us-west2```
deploy-bot: reseed job started (job-id: rs-4982) for tenant fluxware
maya (support): After reseed, customer saw 403 for ~20s then the provision endpoint returned 200.
liam (cs): Great. Sara, please post the customer-facing explanation: SSO ACS mismatch + transient routing/provisioning error we fixed, and set monitoring for 24h. Also propose a small concession if customer is upset.
sara (cs): Drafting message: "Hi Mark — we found two issues: your IdP's ACS URL didn't match the tenant config (we synced it), and a transient routing error caused provisioning to fail (we reseeded your tenant). Both are resolved; please retry the SSO flow and confirm. We'll monitor for 24 hours and can offer a 2-week trial extension if you'd like." Sending now.
anna (sales): Heads-up — FluxWare's ACV upsell hinges on onboarding completion. They're in the upsell cadence next month; keep renewal team updated.
raj (eng): I'll tail provisioner logs and alert if errors reappear: `tail -f /var/log/provisioner/fluxware.log | grep ERROR` — monitoring for 2 hours.
maya (support): Customer replied: "SSO flow works now, onboarding complete. Thanks team." (message received 20m after fix).
sara (cs): Updating account in CRM: onboarding status -> "Completed", renewal risk -> "Cleared". Note: concession offered but not accepted.
liam (cs): Closing escalation. Action summary: Sara update CRM + comms, Raj monitor 2h, Maya follow any further support alerts, Liam to notify renewal team. Thanks all :tada:
